# Contributing to Zazz

Thanks for taking a look. Zazz is a small project with one maintainer, and it's in alpha: the API still changes between minor versions.

If something renders wrong, a primitive misbehaves, or the CLI fails, [open an issue](https://github.com/dereknelsen/zazz-ui/issues/new/choose). A minimal HTML page that reproduces it is the most useful thing you can include, and the [playground](https://zazz.sh/playground/) is a quick way to build one.

For questions, feature ideas, and feedback on the API, use [Discussions](https://github.com/dereknelsen/zazz-ui/discussions). Issues are for bugs.

Please don't report security problems in a public issue. [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) explains how to report them privately.

## Pull requests

I'm not accepting pull requests until the API settles. I'd rather not ask anyone to put work into a branch that the next release makes obsolete. Pull requests from outside the project are closed automatically with a note pointing here.

If you've found a fix, describe it in an issue. A code snippet in the issue is welcome, and I'll credit you in the changelog if it lands.
